'''Fovish''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as an [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]], she was stationed in the [[Imperial base camp]].

==Behind the scenes==
Fovish first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as the Specialty Goods vendor on Ilum for the Empire.<ref name="TOR" />
